summary: Spatial tree nearest-neighbor search over a linked node structure. Given a query point a2 and an identifier a4, descends and walks the node chains (+268 siblings, +272 children) keeping the node with minimum squared distance, with identifier checks (+300). When the tree walk yields no candidate (null node) or the optional plane test (a5) rejects the candidate, it falls back to SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest. Used by AI racing-line / steering callers.

local_names.v6: initial node retained for child walk

operations.description: If starting node a3 is null, call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return its result.
If a3+300 != a4 and a3+276 is nonzero and (a3+276)+300 == a4, switch the working node to a3+276.
Compute squared distance from query point a2 to the node position stored at +148/+152/+156.
Walk the +268 sibling chain while distance decreases and node+300 == a4, tracking the closest node; if the chain ends, call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return.
Walk the +272 child chain while distance decreases, tracking the closest node; if the chain ends, call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return.
If a5 (plane-test flag) is set and the closest node fails the plane-side test computed from +164/+172 coefficients and its +148/+156 position, advance to the +272 child.
Return the closest node, or call SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(this, a2, a4) and return its result if no node was selected.
